means: A proposed law. It becomes law only if the House and the Senate both pass it and the President signs it.
To formally propose a bill. The member who introduces it is called its sponsor.
To add your name in support of a bill someone else introduced. It is not a vote. The official word is "cosponsor."
also: co-sign cosign co-signed cosigned co-signing cosponsor co-sponsor cosponsored signed onto

means: A proposed change to a bill. Each one gets its own vote before the bill itself does.
A vote where each member's yes or no is written down by name. Those are the votes this site shows. It is also called a roll call.
A Senate vote to start working on a bill. Voting yes means "let's debate this," not "I support it."
also: motion to proceed taken up begin work open debate

means: A Senate vote to stop talking and move toward a final vote. It usually takes 60 of the 100 senators. The official word is "cloture."
also: cloture filibuster end debate debate ended 60 votes

means: The vote on the bill itself, after the debate and the amendments are done.
A vote to drop a proposal without voting on the proposal itself. The official word is "tabling."
also: table tabled tabling set aside motion to table

means: Senators voted on whether to pull a measure out of committee and bring it to the full Senate. The vote failed, so the measure went no further.
The Senate's vote to approve someone the President picked for a job, such as a judge or a cabinet secretary. The person is called a nominee.
A bill that gives federal agencies the money to operate for a year. The official word is "appropriations."
A short-term funding bill that keeps the government open when the full-year bills are not finished. The official name is a "continuing resolution."
The yearly bill that sets military policy and how much the military is allowed to spend. Its official name is the National Defense Authorization Act.
also: ndaa national defense authorization act defense bill

means: The leader of the party with the most seats in the Senate, chosen by that party's senators. The leader of the other party is the Minority Leader.
also: minority leader senate leader party leader

means: A two-year term of the House and Senate. This is the 119th Congress, which runs from January 3, 2025 to January 3, 2027.
